title: The 10 Best Smart Pet Feeders
subtitle: Wi-Fi automatic feeders for cats and dogs, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the Wi-Fi automatic pet feeders on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: cameras, battery backup, and capacity.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.a: Almost all automatic feeders handle dry kibble only. Check the kibble size limits in the listing.

buyers_guide.q: What if the power or Wi-Fi goes out?
buyers_guide.a: Look for battery backup. Most feeders keep their schedule locally and keep feeding without Wi-Fi; you just lose app control and alerts.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need the camera version?
buyers_guide.a: A camera lets you watch your pet eat and confirms the food actually dropped. If you just want reliable meals, the non-camera version is cheaper.
